name: Gravelords Blade
description: (Tag:curse)(Tag:martial)(Tag:necro)Channel the Gravelords' Blade into any weapon or your body, suffusing it with Death and Curses. It greatly amplifies destruction per energy expended; living wounds gain Gravelord's Curse, nearly unhealable, spreading death essence for damage over time and weakness, with a chance to instantly kill weaker targets, costing energy to maintain. Inanimate objects corrode and degrade. You can also fire projectiles, extend the weapon, or manifest a pure-energy weapon for extra cost.
